categories.main_business_segments: Shanghai Haohai Biological Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in four major therapeutic areas: medical aesthetics and wound care, ophthalmology, orthopedics, and anti-adhesion and hemostasis products. The company focuses on the research, development, manufacturing, and sales of biomedical materials including HA Dermal Fillers, ophthalmic intraocular lenses (IOLs), orthopedic sodium hyaluronate injections, and anti-adhesion materials.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced biomedical materials technology and genetic engineering technology. Key technologies include independent development of cross-linking processes for HA Dermal Fillers (monophase, low-temperature secondary, linear non-particle, organic cross-linking), one-time injection molding for IOLs, and genetic engineering for human epidermal growth factor (hEGF) products. The company also engages in clinical trials and registration of innovative products such as organic cross-linked HA Dermal Fillers, hydrophobic molded toric aspheric IOLs, and high oxygen permeability Orthokeratology lenses.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers include medical institutions, doctors, and end consumers in the medical aesthetics, ophthalmology, orthopedics, and surgical fields. The company serves hospitals, clinics, and specialized medical aesthetic institutions, targeting patients requiring treatments such as cataract surgery, myopia prevention and correction, osteoarthritis treatment, and wound care. The products are used in both clinical and aesthetic applications.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in Mainland China, which accounts for the majority of its revenue and assets. It also has significant operations and sales in Europe, the USA, and other regions. Subsidiaries and production facilities are located in Shanghai and other parts of China, with international subsidiaries such as Contamac in the UK and EndyMed in Israel, serving global markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: Shanghai Haohai Biological Technology Co., Ltd. operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the biomedical materials supply chain. It engages in R&D, manufacturing, and sales of finished biomedical products such as HA Dermal Fillers, IOLs, and orthopedic injections. The company also controls upstream raw material production through subsidiaries like Contamac, which manufactures ophthalmic and optometry materials.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes independent innovation and increased R&D investment, focusing on expanding product lines in medical aesthetics and ophthalmology. Key R&D initiatives include development of organic cross-linked HA Dermal Fillers, hydrophobic molded toric aspheric IOLs, bio-gel intraocular fillers, and high oxygen permeability Orthokeratology lenses. The company also pursues technology introduction and investment collaborations to enhance its product pipeline and maintain technological leadership.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of biomedical materials and medical devices across its four main business segments. The company also derives income from commissioned research services and performance compensation from subsidiaries. It distributes dividends to shareholders and engages in share repurchase programs to enhance shareholder value.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic player in China’s biomedical materials market, holding top market shares in ophthalmic viscoelastic devices (OVD) and orthopedic intra-articular viscoelastic supplements. It is recognized as a leading domestic brand in HA Dermal Fillers and a major supplier in the domestic IOL market. The company faces competition intensified by new entrants and regulatory reforms but maintains competitive advantages through technology, product portfolio breadth, and brand recognition.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB2.68 billion, representing a 1.7% increase from 2023, with net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB420 million, remaining stable year-on-year. Total assets were RMB7.12 billion with a gearing ratio of 16.9%. The company has demonstrated steady growth with ongoing investments in R&D (8.92% of revenue) and maintains a stable financial position with increasing cash flows from operations.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes differentiated development through innovative biomedical materials and genetic engineering technologies. Its HA Dermal Filler products are positioned across multiple market tiers with unique cross-linking technologies providing long-lasting and natural effects. The company offers a comprehensive ophthalmology product portfolio with advanced IOL technologies and high oxygen permeability Orthokeratology lenses. It leverages strong R&D capabilities, product quality, and extensive marketing and service platforms to provide superior clinical efficacy and customer support, fostering strong brand loyalty and market leadership.
